description: Simulation assumptions for NITK campus mobility transit speeds across road types. These are conservative simulation parameters and not empirical NITK measurements.

notes.internal_campus_road: Primary paved campus thoroughfares (e.g. NITK Spine, Main Gate Road, Main Building Ring Road, Beach Road).
notes.slow_campus_road: Hostel interior lanes, delivery alleys, and mess access paths.
notes.underpass_crossing: Vehicle underpass passage beneath NH-66 connecting East and West campus.
notes.walking_path: Pedestrian footpaths, overpass steps, and building entrance walkways.
